prompt:
Implement `ArchitectureClient.java` as a single-file Java client that turns the supplied separately managed VMware estate into a concrete VCF architecture. The client is invoked as `java ArchitectureClient estate-inventory.json architecture.json research.md` and must use only the Java standard library. Do not modify `TestMain.java`, the estate fixture, the installer specification, or `architecture-schema.json`.

Before implementing the architecture, research current Broadcom-published compatibility, interoperability, and upgrade-path material for the versions in `estate-inventory.json`. In particular, resolve the case where a component build is newer than the corresponding component in the estate's requested VCF bundle and therefore cannot be treated as an ordinary upgrade. Also research the supported transition for the separately deployed recovery products. Record the Broadcom pages consulted in `research.md`; use one entry per page in this exact four-line form: `- Title: <page title>`, `  URL: <HTTPS URL>`, `  Accessed: <YYYY-MM-DD>`, and `  Decision: <short note about the decision this page informed>`.

Write `architecture.json` as an architecture artifact conforming to `architecture-schema.json`. It must contain: (1) a greenfield `greenfieldSpec` expressed as an `SddcSpec` for VCF 9.1 and derived from the fixture's greenfield inputs; (2) the requested bundle rejection and selected bundle; and (3) an ordered brownfield migration plan that brings the entire inventory under the one fleet named in the fixture. Every inventory component must have a component record naming its current version, supported final target, applicable gate IDs, and transition IDs. Every transition in the supported paths must occur exactly once, in dependency order, and no blocked transition may appear. The plan must include the required convergence of the recovery appliances. `research.md` is an audit record separate from the machine-checked architecture and must not be embedded in `architecture.json`.

The `greenfieldSpec` must conform to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract. Run `java TestMain.java` from the project directory for acceptance.

research.product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 architecture and brownfield estate convergence
research.interface: Current Broadcom compatibility, interoperability, upgrade-path, and recovery-product publications
